03. Waterfall vs Agile

SIMPLE ENGLISH
Waterfall emphasizes sequential phases and upfront planning. Agile emphasizes iterative
delivery, collaboration, feedback and adaptation.
සිංහJලෙන් Waterfall වල වුඩ පියවJරන් පියවර ඉදිරියට යනවා. Agile වල කුඩා Jකාටස් deliver කරලා

A stable regulatory project may plan heavily upfront; a new shopping feature benefits from
repeated customer feedback.

Q: Does Agile mean no planning?
A: No. Planning is continuous and can be adapted as evidence changes.
